snippet.title: Return of the King Campaign - Trailer
snippet.description:
Find your courage, and master your fate. An epic RTS campaign covering the events of the Return of the King, merging book and film narratives, coming to Age of the Ring.

Age of the Ring is a standalone modification to BFME2: Rise of the Witch-king. 

To play the current version, all you need is this: 
https://www.moddb.com/mods/the-horse-lords-a-total-modification-for-bfme/downloads/age-of-the-ring-version-90
Support us on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/AotRmodding
Join us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/MB8Kj9N
